title: Mixing: Jealous Guy, Crippled Inside by John Lennon | 1971
content:
Ascot Sound Studios
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Eddie Klein

A mixing session for John Lennon’s second solo album Imagine took place on 2 June 1971.

Stereo mixes of ‘Jealous Guy’ and ‘Crippled Inside’ were made. Lennon and Yoko Ono were not present, however, as they had arrived in New York City the day before.
